name: 콘치
motifs: White smooth armor with flowing orange-edged fin-shaped trim and a compact cream horn-shaped hair ornament; orange patches become painted plate patterns, flowing tail fin becomes a short white and orange split waist drape. Human lips, face and limbs, no fish costume.
light: In an airy white stone river pavilion at sunrise, graceful front three-quarter adult woman. Predominantly pearl-white slim armor with vivid orange patches and rippling orange-edged skirt panels, compact cream horn ornament above brow. Human face and skin entirely clear, both open hands beside hips, full head and boots with margins.
casual: In an empty sunlit dance rehearsal studio at midday, taking a light dance step with one foot pointed and both arms extending separately in a graceful curve, both hands readable. Entire figure and bare feet, plain tall windows, no mirrors or reflections.

Opaque white fitted cap-sleeve cropped dance top with secure scoop neckline and orange high-waisted flowing wrap skirt over opaque short dance shorts. Bare forearms midriff and legs, tiny cream horn hairclip.

At the clear sandy edge of a quiet inland river on a golden late afternoon, kneeling on dry sand at the waterline to cup a little water in one hand while the other open hand rests separately on her knee. Head to above knees, both hands clear, gentle current and willow shadows.

Fully lined opaque orange two-piece swimsuit with broad white-edged straps, securely fitted full-coverage top and high-waisted white-panel bottoms. Chest and pelvis fully covered, bare shoulders arms midriff legs, small pearl earrings.

In a quiet handmade paper studio at blue dawn, side-on at a table pulling a blank orange paper print from a flat press, two hands holding opposite wide corners with separated fingers. Face turned slightly toward viewer, damp paper stacks and cool window light.

Opaque white sleeveless square-neck tailored waistcoat with secure buttons and orange high-waisted loose trousers below crop, minimal cream pendant. Bare shoulders arms upper chest and small midriff, no apron or armor.
